description: Identical seeded initial shots and fixed120Hz simulation; no shot or ball tuning changes. All active seats use ordinary bot controls. Full source comparison includes support/recovery changes in the integrated candidate.

metrics.successfulDefensiveTouches: A physical defender touch while the live homing target before that tick threatens its own goal; does not require a SAVE label.
metrics.doubleCommitSeconds: Two or more SAVE controllers simultaneously target points less than7metres apart.
metrics.strandedCarSeconds: Raw low-speed(<.6m/s) time in actual contact while more than3metres from its current target; includes startup and short braking/turning phases, not proof of a persistent stall.
metrics.roleSwitches: Raw changes to INTERCEPTOR/COVER/GOALKEEPER or baseline mode; higher touch counts and longer rallies create more legitimate changes. Compare exposure-normalized rate as well.
metrics.meanOutgoingPositionError: Distance to a fixed independent defensive home lane, while the ball heads away and the car is not attacking or saving.

policyOnly.description: QA-only overlay: frozen10.6vehicle/ball/input physics and assets, with only candidate planBot/bot/teamPlan/recovery callback/claim guard and distinct Heatseeker module. It is never a release build.
